q: Can I use a handwritten diesel bill from a local supplier for carbon reporting?
title: Handwritten fuel bills as evidence
short: Yes, if it shows the date, supplier, litres and your business name, and you can back it with a payment record. A verifier will look for a matching bank or cash entry and your stock or logbook. Where a bill lacks litres, record how you converted it.
audience: MSMEs buying diesel from small dealers

ul: Date of supply and the supplier's name or stamp.
Quantity in litres, not only a rupee amount.
A payment entry in your books that matches it.

p: Keep a simple register: date, litres received, where the fuel went. A handwritten bill plus a register reads far better than either alone.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure tied to its invoice, factor and method version, so a verifier can trace any number back to the document it came from.

sources.label: ISO 14064-3, verification of greenhouse gas statements (iso.org)
